## Memory profiler report (hive-1791638042611-puqtiv, worker under queen-hybrid)

### Summary
I made two changes, committed locally on `perf/mcp-memory` (worktree `C:\Users\mariu\ruflo-wt-memory`, not pushed). Together they take an idle ruflo MCP session from 2 node processes, 149 MB working set and 74 MB private memory down to 1 process, 81 MB and 48 MB. Time from spawn to the `initialize` reply drops from about 1.3 s to about 0.7 s. tools/list is byte-identical before and after (sha256 `8a723dc0d83cc751f30bc8855a1805d9313d13f7df772d36851f00fc925ea05c`, 358 tools). The tool results I tested match apart from timestamps, pids and timings.

The idle server is not where most of the memory goes on this machine, though. The long-running sessions are far bigger (see "Biggest consumers").

### Baseline (global CLI 3.56.3, Node 24.21, after GC, idle after initialize + tools/list)
| Setup | node procs | Working set MB | Private MB | heapUsed MB | spawn→init |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| bare `node` (empty stdio echo server) | 1 | 61.1 | 21.9 | 4.3 | 673 ms |
| `node cli.js mcp start` (direct) | 1 | 87.2 | 51.5 | 15.6 | 728 ms |
| current: mcp-launch.cjs → child cli | 2 | 149.3 | 74.0 | 15.6 | 1320 ms |
| old: `npx -y @claude-flow/cli@latest` (npx-cli.js + cli) | 2 | 255.3 | 216.2 | — | 2297 ms |

- The npx wrapper on its own holds **164 MB private** even after GC, with 543 npm modules loaded. Under the old setup each session paid launcher + npx + cli, roughly 238 MB private.
- After one `memory_store` call the server grows from 54 to **257 MB private**. Heap only rises to 24 MB, so almost all of that growth is native memory.

### Biggest consumers (file:line)
1. **Embeddings stack, loaded on the first memory/embeddings call** (`v3/@claude-flow/cli/src/memory/memory-initializer.ts:2350-2370`). It loads `@huggingface/transformers` 4.3.1 with `pipeline('feature-extraction','Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2')`, which pulls in onnxruntime-node and also sharp/libvips. On v4 this loads the **fp32 90 MB `model.onnx`**, not the 23 MB quantized one. In isolation: pipeline load +157 MB private, then +86 MB after 60 embeddings, about 285 MB in total. Setting `session_options: {enableCpuMemArena:false}` made no measurable difference. Switching to q8 would change embedding values, so I did not do it (recommendation only).
2. **Live sessions:** three `cli.js mcp start` processes hold 879, 764 and 338 MB private, with 52–84 threads each. That fits item 1 plus growth over time. I did not profile them further.
3. **Not ruflo-MCP, but large:** 19 `npx --prefer-offline @claude-flow/cli hooks statusline --json` processes, about **1.7 GB private** in total. Some are 35+ minutes old, so they look stuck. There are also 17 daemon processes using about 970 MB. These come from statusline/daemon config outside my scope; I did not touch or kill them.
4. **Idle startup graph** (only 149 files / 2.6 MB of JS load; no onnx, agentdb or hnswlib at idle):
   - `src/services/policy-runtime.ts:1-16` imported the whole `@claude-flow/security` barrel. That evaluates bcryptjs, keychain, [SENSITIVE_PATH] helpers and `oauth/callback-server.js`.
   - The static `import { createServer } from 'node:http'` in `src/mcp-tools/browser-intent-tools.ts:89` and `src/mcp-tools/agentbbs-federation.ts:57` (and the one in the security barrel) makes Node load undici at startup. Measured in isolation: an ESM import of node:http costs +2.5 MB heap / +6.6 MB private, while `require('node:http')` costs +0.1 MB.
   - About 4.9 MB of heap is the retained module source text, which is inherent to the files loaded.

### Changes (2 commits)
1. **`9c88f2b88` perf(ruflo-core): run resolved local CLI in-process in mcp-launch** (`plugins/ruflo-core/scripts/mcp-launch.cjs` and its test)
   - When a local or global CLI is found, the launcher now runs it in its own process (sets `process.argv` to `[node, <bin>/cli.js, 'mcp', 'start']`, then `import()`s it) instead of spawning a second node.
   - The npx fallback still spawns as before. `RUFLO_MCP_SPAWN=1` restores the old child-process behaviour.
   - Added a test; `node --test mcp-launch.test.cjs` passes 11/11.
2. **`d38562791` perf(cli): keep node:http and the security barrel off the MCP startup path**
   - `policy-runtime.ts` now imports from `@claude-flow/security/policy/index` and `@claude-flow/security/mcp-caller-identity`. These resolve through the package's `"./*"` export, the same pattern `/safe-git` already uses.
   - The two tool files call `require('node:http')` lazily at the point a server is created.

### Before/after evidence (median of 3 runs, post-GC)
| Config | procs | idle WS | idle Priv | after 4 calls WS/Priv | heapUsed | spawn→init |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A: old launcher + base dist | 2 | 149.3 | 74.0 | 157.9 / 76.2 | 15.6 | 1320 ms |
| B: new launcher + base dist | 1 | 87.6 | 52.2 | 96.2 / 56.1 | 15.6 | 729 ms |
| C0: direct, base dist | 1 | 87.2 | 51.5 | 97.2 / 55.9 | 15.6 | 728 ms |
| C1: direct, patched dist | 1 | 81.5 | 47.7 | 83.9 / 49.7 | 13.2 | 716 ms |
| D: new launcher + patched dist | 1 | 81.3 | 48.0 | 86.2 / 51.0 | 13.2 | 710 ms |

- **tools/list:** sha256 `8a723dc0…a05c` in every run, and `cmp` of the saved JSON shows them identical.
- **Tool results:** `system_info`, `system_status`, `system_health`, `config_list`, `policy_status`, `memory_store` and `memory_search` differ only in pid, uptime, timestamps, latency and timing fields.
- **Tool timings:** 6–13 ms either way. After `memory_store`, private memory is 256 MB on base vs 238.5 MB patched (single run).

### Re-run commands
Scratch directory: `C:\Users\mariu\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Users-mariu\df94bcb2-bb9e-4b80-9213-ad91653deca4\scratchpad\mem`
1. Run `powershell -File setup-pkgs.ps1`. It recreates the dependency junctions that point into the global install; I already removed them safely. The `pkg-base` and `pkg-new` CLI copies are still there, and `pkg-new` already has change #2 patched into its dist.
2. Run `bash matrix.sh <label> <old|new|direct> <base|new> 3`. It runs `harness.mjs` with `probe.cjs` (a GC + `process.memoryUsage` dump) plus PowerShell `Get-Process` WorkingSet64/PrivateMemorySize64 sampling.
3. Run `setup-pkgs.ps1 -Remove` afterwards. Do **not** `rm -rf` the pkg dirs while the junctions exist.

### Unverified
- Change #2 was **not built or type-checked with tsc**: the sparse worktree has no dependencies. I proved it on a hand-patched copy of the 3.56.3 dist, and checked that the `.d.ts` files for the subpaths exist in security 3.0.3.
- The in-process launcher was measured via `RUFLO_MCP_CLI_OVERRIDE`, not through a real Claude Code session.
- On Windows, the old launcher's SIGINT/SIGTERM forwarding is no longer needed, but I did not test that path.
- The live hogs (q8 model, stuck statusline npx processes, daemons) are recommendations only.

### Side effects
My harness runs wrote ruflo state into scratch working directories. The CLI also appears to keep per-path policy anchor state outside the working directory: re-runs in a reused or copied directory got `policy-anchor-log-missing` / `rolled-back`. I worked around it with fresh unique directories.

Branch: `perf/mcp-memory`. `git log --oneline -3`:
```

9c88f2b88 perf(ruflo-core): run resolved local CLI in-process in mcp-launch
6c046548e Merge pull request #3957 from ruvnet/feat/ruvnet-brain-grounding
```
